subject: S15 decision: AssistantAsk pdf_page context carries a page image
body: apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts (landed in b96d7fe): AssistantAsk context may be {kind:'pdf_page', item_id, page, text?, image?: Blob}. The Library PDF viewer passes the rendered page canvas as a PNG Blob (capped at 1600px long edge) plus the extracted page text. Server side, the page text is readable via naadi_api.ingest.routes.read_page_text(conn, user_id, item_id, page) (owner-only, vault items refused). When your agent/tools/registry.py lands I'll add get_page for pdf_page and add_to_knowledge (writes=True, requires_flag='library'); your rebase conflict in ask.ts: please keep both your changes and the pdf_page branch. Ping me if you want me to resolve it on my side.
